result.name: Field Alpha US Adult Gamers (Census Grounded Nov 2026)
result.summary:
Panel 'Field Alpha US Adult Gamers (Census Grounded Nov 2026)': 12/12 personas generated
Age range: 22-76, median 41
Gender: Male: 6, Female: 6
Income: 50-75k: 3, 25-50k: 3, 75-100k: 2, 100-150k: 2, <25k: 1
Top locations: Columbus, USA (1), Phoenix, USA (1), Atlanta, USA (1)
Top roles: Community College Student and Part-Time Grocery Clerk (1), IT Support Specialist (1), Marketing Manager (1), Senior Project Manager (1), Warehouse Shift Supervisor (1)
COMPOSITION: sampled to real population marginals on gender. Invented by the generator, not sampled: age, race, education, income. Do not describe the panel as matching Census data on those. independence — marginals matched, correlation not modelled. Caveats: gender: no Census counts for this panel; used the US adult split.

notes: gender: no Census counts for this panel; used the US adult split
